_comment: Curated on-computer models (R16). Every entry: Apache-2.0 or MIT licence only, instruction-tuned, OpenAI-style tool calling through llama.cpp --jinja, GGUF Q4_K_M. url is pinned to a Hugging Face commit; sizeBytes + sha256 are that commit's LFS size + oid (verified 2026-10-15 via the HF API /tree/main). minRamBytes = the highest llama-server peak RSS measured in R16 (M1 Pro 16 GB, Metal, q8_0 KV, ctx up to 32k; scripts/r16/measure_local.py) + 1 GiB headroom (f16 KV on Windows/Linux, runtime), rounded up to 50 MB. diskNeededBytes = sizeBytes + 10%, rounded up.
_recommendedByTier_comment: Set by R16 measurement (12-scenario battery + 12 probes, k=1, ranked by clean trials = correct tool use and no invented figure, speed second). Pooled over 16k+32k ctx: qwen3.5-4b 29/36 clean (5 trials with an invented figure), granite-4.2-3b 26/36 (6), qwen3.5-9b 18/24 (1), granite-4.2-8b 16/24 (3). MEASURED: 16gb (32k ctx, this machine class) and the under-8gb ctx (16k, on 16 GB hardware). INFERRED: 8gb (24k ctx) and 32gb (64k ctx), and under-8gb hardware itself.
